unsubscribe.intro.go_live: You will no longer get an email when channels you follow go live. In-app and browser notifications are not affected.
unsubscribe.intro.governance: You will no longer get emails about new co-op votes and their results.
unsubscribe.done.title: You are unsubscribed
unsubscribe.done.go_live: You will no longer get go-live emails. You can turn them back on in your notification settings.
unsubscribe.done.governance: You will no longer get co-op governance emails. You can turn them back on in your notification settings.
unsubscribe.invalid.title: This unsubscribe link does not work
unsubscribe.invalid.body: The link may be incomplete or out of date. Open it again from the email, or choose your emails in your notification settings.
unsubscribe.failed: Could not unsubscribe. Please try again.
